target.name: Protein lipoylation
target.description: Protein lipoylation builds the lipoyl cofactor inside mitochondria and attaches it to the handful of enzymes that cannot run without it: the E2 subunits of pyruvate, 2-oxoglutarate, 2-oxoadipate and branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenases, plus the glycine cleavage system. target.name: Glucagon-type ligand receptors
target.description: Glucagon-type ligand receptors are the class B, secretin-like G protein-coupled receptors through which peptide hormones released by gut, pancreas and hypothalamus set blood glucose, appetite, digestive secretion and growth. target.name: riboflavin metabolic process

target.name: wybutosine biosynthetic process
target.description: Phenylalanine tRNA carries a bulky tricyclic modification next to the anticodon, and wybutosine biosynthesis is the multi-step route that builds it.
